answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed when peers attest misbehavior, so spawning thousands of fake identities costs real capital per identity. New agents earn trust only through an ocean of verifiable, attested work over time, never instant self-declared reputation, and an echo chamber of sock-puppets cannot inflate scores because attestations are weighted by the attester's own staked history. A sudden gale of new identities gains nothing without capital and time.
